mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Ministry of Planning and Investment – Business Registration Office (for VN) or foreign competent authority

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, directors, UBOs, and authorized signatories against the consolidated OFAC SDN list, UN Security Council consolidated list, EU consolidated financial sanctions list, and Vietnamese domestic lists published by the State Bank of Viet Nam (SBV), the Ministry of Public Security, and the Department of Anti-Money Laundering Supervision under the SBV. PEP status shall be verified through official databases and certified self-declarations subject to adverse-media checks and enhanced due diligence as required under Article 9 of Law No. 07/2022/QH15.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Business Registration Portal (Cổng thông tin quốc gia về đăng ký doanh nghiệp) at https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The registered company name must be written in Vietnamese script using the official alphabet, numerals, and symbols. Foreign names may be included in parentheses alongside the Vietnamese name. The Vietnamese name must contain at least two words, use standard orthographic rules, and cannot be a direct transliteration from a foreign language unless properly romanized and distinct from existing names. Names must not be identical or confusingly similar to any existing legal entity name in the national business registry.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank (Ngân hàng) – requires prior approval from the State Bank of Viet Nam
Foundation (Quỹ) – requires prior approval from the relevant ministry for charitable/nonprofit licensing
Central (Trung ương) – when combined with state names
Private charity (Từ thiện) – requires license verification from the Ministry of Home Affairs or provincial equivalent
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection by the Business Registration Office, an administrative appeal must be filed in writing with the Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) within 30 days from the date of rejection. The appeal shall include the proposed name, registry reference number, and legal arguments demonstrating compliance with Law No. 59/2020/QH14 and Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP. If rejected again, the applicant may initiate an administrative lawsuit at the provincial Administrative Court within 30 days of the second rejection. Concurrently, a fresh name application may be resubmitted using a materially different name to avoid delay.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office is not permissible for a private charitable foundation because the entity is required to have a physical registered office within Vietnam, accessible for government inspections, and staffed during local business hours in accordance with Article 27 of Law No. 59/2020/QH14 and specialized foundation regulations.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High (approximately 65-75% risk of unannounced on-site inspections during the first 18 months) due to the charitable endowment business scope, the necessity for a statutory license from a social affairs ministry, and heightened AML/CFT supervision of nonprofit organisations to detect terrorism financing risks.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14, particularly Articles 24–38 (incorporation procedure, company charter, capital contribution), Articles 39–48 (name and registered office), Articles 49–61 (general rights and obligations of companies), Articles 73–93 (limited liability companies with one member), and Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP on enterprise registration. For foreign-invested charitable endowment entities, additionally Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14 and Decree No. 31/2021/ND-CP.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Business Registration Office, Agency for Business Registration, Ministry of Planning and Investment; acting through the provincial Department of Planning and Investment where the company's registered head office is located.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Enterprise Registration (Giấy đề nghị đăng ký doanh nghiệp) together with the Company Charter (Điều lệ công ty) as prescribed under Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital under general enterprise law for a private charitable endowment LLC; however, the charter capital must be fully paid within 90 days from issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate, and the company must maintain capital reasonably sufficient for the contemplated grant-making and endowment management activities. There is no escrow account requirement under the Law on Enterprises; capital is paid into a Vietnamese commercial bank account opened in the company's name, and the bank's payment confirmation serves as evidence of contribution.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
RESOLUTION OF THE SOLE MEMBER AND FIRST BOARD OF MEMBERS OF [COMPANY NAME] (LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY)

WHEREAS the sole member has resolved to establish a single-member limited liability company under the Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 and Decrees No. 01/2021/ND-CP and No. 31/2021/ND-CP; and
WHEREAS the company's registered business line includes endowment management for philanthropic and scientific grants (ISIC 6430);

NOW, THEREFORE, IT IS RESOLVED AS FOLLOWS:

1. SUBSCRIPTION OF CHARTER CAPITAL: The sole member subscribes to 100% of the charter capital of [VND__] (in words: __), to be contributed in full to the company's dedicated bank account within 90 days of the Enterprise Registration Certificate date. The first legal representative is authorized to open such account.

2. ADOPTION OF REGISTERED OFFICE: The registered head office of the company is hereby established at [full address in Viet Nam] and the Board authorizes the legal representative to execute the lease, evidence lawful use of premises, and file the address in the National Enterprise Registration Database.

3. APPOINTMENT OF OFFICERS: (a) [Name] is appointed President of the Company and legal representative (Chủ tịch công ty / người đại diện theo pháp luật) with power to sign all incorporation filings; (b) [Name] is appointed Director/General Director with day-to-day authority and fiduciary responsibility over grant administration; (c) [Name] is appointed Chief Accountant, or alternatively the Board resolves to retain a licensed accounting service under the Law on Accounting No. 88/2015/QH13.

4. ADOPTION OF GOVERNANCE INSTRUMENTS: The Board adopts the Company Charter, internal financial control and grant disbursement policy, and anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing procedures consistent with State Bank of Viet Nam Circular No. 09/2023/TT-NHNN.

5. CORPORATE SEAL AND ELECTRONIC SIGNATURE: The company shall procure a corporate seal, register the seal specimen with the National Business Registration Portal, and obtain a digital signature certificate for the legal representative for e-filings.

6. BANKING ARRANGEMENTS: The operating account shall be designated for receipt of endowment contributions and for effecting approved grant and expense payments under dual-signature authorization.

7. GENERAL AUTHORIZATION: The President and, in his or her absence, the Director may execute all documents necessary to implement this resolution.

ADOPTED this [day] day of [month], [year] at [place], Viet Nam.

[Signature of sole member and witness if required]

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-incorporation name clearance and investment eligibility screening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Business Registration Portal (DichVuCong.gov.vn) administered by the Agency for Business Registration, Ministry of Planning and Investment; for investment approval aspects, the provincial Department of Planning and Investment.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the proposed company name online and obtain a non-duplication check against the National Enterprise Registration Database. Ensure the proposed name complies with Articles 37–41 of Law on Enterprises and does not duplicate or confuse with an existing entity name. Screen the activity 'Endowment Management for Philanthropic and Scientific Grants' against conditional business lines and prohibited investment sectors under Annex 4 of Decree No. 31/2021/ND-CP; if the sole member is wholly foreign-owned, the entity requires an Investment Registration Certificate in accordance with Law on Investment procedures, unless the capital contribution under the enterprise registration route is below thresholds requiring investment approval. If any conditional requirements apply, obtain prior written approval from the sectoral ministry or register the condition before submitting enterprise registration. The name check is completed through the portal and no separate fee is collected for an online preliminary check.
required_dossiers: Identity document of the proposed legal representative
Power of attorney for a filing agent if used
Proposed company name (Vietnamese and English)
Legal status documents of the sole member where the sole member is a legal entity
Preliminary summary of the business line and investment capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is rejected, select and resubmit a revised name on the portal the same day; no waiting period applies. If the investment activity screening identifies a conditional sector, file the supplemental conditional-approval application with the competent ministry and refile the enterprise application once the approval is granted.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and notarization of the company charter, member resolution, and capital verification file
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public Office (Phòng Công chứng) licensed under Law on Notarization No. 33/2018/QH13; licensed commercial bank for capital certificate.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the company charter in Vietnamese with a dual English text annexed. Execute the sole-member resolution adopting the charter, capital schedule, and officers. Have signatures of the member and legal representative authenticated and duplicate copies certified by the notary. Open a temporary capital account or a 'contributed capital management account' in the name of the company-to-be at a licensed bank in Viet Nam. Deposit the charter capital, in full or according to the schedule, into that account; obtain a payment confirmation/certificate from the bank with signatures of authorized officers. Where the sole member is a foreign entity, legalize and consular-stamp its constituent documents and certified corporate resolutions, and obtain Vietnamese notarized translations. Ensure the charter contains all mandatory content under Articles 26–27 of the Law on Enterprises, including business line 6430, capital, governance policy, and legal representative provisions.
required_dossiers: Company Charter (bilingual as needed, notarized)
Resolution of the sole member on charter capital and officers (notarized)
Payment confirmation or bank certificate of capital contribution
Valid passport/ID of individual signatories; duly legalized incorporation documents of corporate sole member
Power of attorney with notarized translation
Consent of the legal representative to the appointment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary requests amendments, correct the charter and reauthenticate; if bank refuses to issue the capital certificate, use a bank statement showing the deposit from the member's account and obtain a CFO/board explanation. Any legalization deficiency is cured by consular legalization at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs Consular Department within 5 working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of enterprise registration dossier to the provincial Department of Planning and Investment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) via the National Business Registration Portal or its one-stop shop receiving office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete and submit the Application for Enterprise Registration (electronically or physically) together with the notarized charter, list of members, capital certificates, and supporting documents. The DPI issues a receipt; legally, the DPI must issue the Enterprise Registration Certificate within 3 working days from receipt of a valid dossier. Upon issuance, verify the enterprise code and that all business lines (including 6430) are reflected. Simultaneously register the seal specimen within 3 working days after making the seal. Pay the state filing fee at the state budget collection account (approximately USD 27). If the company is 100% foreign-owned, the DPI coordinates with the Investment Registration Agency for the Investment Registration Certificate and likely issues both certificates under the one-window procedure.
required_dossiers: Application for Enterprise Registration
Company Charter
Complete list of members of the single-member LLC and legal representatives' declarations
Notarized passports / legalized constitutional documents of sole member
Lease contract or equivalent evidence of lawful use of the registered head office address
Bank certificate/evidence of charter capital deposited
Power of attorney and copy of filing agent's ID if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DPI issues a request for amendment, cure and resubmit within 10 working days via the same portal. If the DPI refuses the application, file a complaint with the Director of the DPI under Law on Complaints, and thereafter appeal to the Ministry of Planning and Investment or the administrative court. If an Investment Registration Certificate is also required and delayed, coordinate with the Investment Registration Division and supplement with an explanation of the investment project's legal capital perfection.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-registration bank account, tax registration, seal making, and initial corporate records activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: General Department of Taxation (via eTax system); licensed commercial banks; Social Insurance Agency; licensed seal engraving business; digital certification authority licensed by the Ministry of Information and Communications.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After receiving the Enterprise Registration Certificate, convert the temporary capital account into a full corporate operating account (or open a separate operating account) under the company's lawful name. Notify the State Bank of Viet Nam of the account details under Circular No. 09/2023/TT-NHNN within the required deadline. Complete tax registration by updating the taxpayer's profile; the enterprise code functions as the tax code. Register for VAT, CIT, and any required license taxes (although charitable grant-making may be VAT-exempt under Article 4 of the VAT Law No. 13/2008/QH13 as amended; the company still files periodic tax declarations). Register with the social insurance agency if the company hires employees. Commission the corporate stamp/engraving and declare the seal specimen on the National Business Registration Portal within 3 working days from making the seal, attaching a printed image. Obtain a Digital Signature Certificate for the legal representative to sign electronic tax and customs declarations.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Registration Certificate (scanned certified copy)
Tax registration declaration form 05-ĐK-TCT
Company charter and bank confirmation for account opening
Seal specimen declaration form with seal image
Certificate of digital signature application and fee payment receipt
Labor registration and social insurance enrollment forms if staff engaged
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank imposes AML/KYC delays due to cross-border grantors, provide board resolutions, source-of-wealth declarations, and organizational charts. If tax registration encounters a system mismatch, contact the local tax authority helpdesk and resubmit the form with a correction notice. If the seal specimen declaration is rejected, recarve the seal to match the company name and code and redeclare. Any missed deadline may be cured by filing a late-correction notice, subject to administrative fines under Decree 122/2021/ND-CP if penalties are assessed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Installation of registered signboard and commencement of charitable endowment operations under sector-specific regulatory notices
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial Department of Planning and Investment (registered address verification); Ministry of Home Affairs and provincial People's Committee for charitable fund registration where applicable; Ministry of Finance for tax treatment of grants; local People's Committee for workplace safety and fire prevention inspection.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Physically affix the company name board at the registered office with the company name and enterprise code. Ensure the chief accountant's appointment is registered (if appointed) or the accounting service contract is retained. For an ISIC 6430 charitable endowment operating as a private foundation, determine whether its operations involve 'social fundraising' under Decree No. 93/2019/ND-CP; if yes, obtain the relevant charitable fund or fundraising approval from the Ministry of Home Affairs / provincial People's Committee under Law on Associations. If the foundation restricts activity to internal endowment management and grant distribution from private funds without public fundraising, no additional Home Affairs permit is required, but the company should still adopt a written AML/Grant-Due-Diligence policy because it may be an 'obliged entity' under anti-money laundering regulations. Subject to the building type, apply for fire safety acceptance (thẩm duyệt phòng cháy chữa cháy) from the local Fire Police under Decree No. 136/2020/ND-CP, obtain workplace environmental measurement from a licensed agency for health clearance, and post the company's EH&S obligations. Maintain statutory registers: member register, charter capital contribution ledger, minutes of member's resolutions, and accounting records in Vietnamese dong.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Registration Certificate and Investment Registration Certificate (if any)
Seal specimen confirmed by registry
Lease contract and construction/occupancy certificate of office premises
Fire safety acceptance records or building owner's fire safety certificate
AML policy, grant policy, and internal control manual
Director/legal representative's appointment acceptance signed
Charitable fund registration or non-public-funding declaration as applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the signboard inspection by the DPI identifies non-compliance or the office is not found, cure by immediate installation and submit a corrective explanatory note; potential administrative fine under Decree 122/2021/ND-CP may be reduced if voluntary correction is effected. If sectoral regulation requires a charitable registration that was not anticipated, file the supplementary registration with the Ministry of Home Affairs and interim suspend active public fundraising until the permit is issued; private grant distribution from a lawfully incorporated entity is not prohibited.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Because ISIC 6430 is an administrative trust/fund management activity rather than manufacturing, no classic industrial licensing authority applies. Competent authorities: Ministry of Home Affairs (charitable fund and association registration), Ministry of Finance (endowment fund governance and tax administration of charitable grant entities), State Bank of Viet Nam (AML supervision for obliged entities), and the provincial Department of Planning and Investment (enterprise/investment registration).
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Enterprise Registration Certificate; additionally, if the PRIVATE CHARITABLE FOUNDATION conducts public fundraising or operates as a social fund, a 'Registration Certificate of Charitable Fund' or 'Decision on Permitting the Establishment of a Charitable Fund' under Decree No. 93/2019/ND-CP; no separate general operating license for pure private endowment grant-making. For physical office operations, a fire safety acceptance certificate and environmental registration are required as described below.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment of Viet Nam (MONRE) and provincial Department of Natural Resources and Environment (DONRE), with the provincial People's Committee as coordinating authority.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — the endowment management charitable foundation is an administrative office/non-industrial activity listed under category III of the Law on Environmental Protection No. 72/2020/QH13 and Decree No. 08/2022/ND-CP. Because the business does not involve manufacturing or one of the listed high-risk categories, no Full EIA report or EIA registration is required; the company must, however, obtain a domestic wastewater discharge registration or comply with municipal sewer discharge arrangements, and sign an environmental commitment form if any small-scale office discharge exists.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance thresholds under QCVN 14:2008/BTNMT for domestic wastewater (BOD5 ≤ 30 mg/L; TSS ≤ 50 mg/L; total coliforms ≤ 3,000 MPN/100 mL; pH 5–9); for office-generated solid waste, apply Decree No. 08/2022/ND-CP classification and transfer to licensed collectors; for hazardous waste (e.g., batteries, fluorescent lamps, electronic equipment), register as a waste generator in the national hazardous waste database and maintain a transfer log if quantities exceed 600 kg/year; if the office emits VOCs through minor stationery/printing operations, maintain general indoor air quality compliance with QCVN 06:2009/BYT and ensure the ventilation system does not cause off-site nuisance emissions.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety clearance: obtain the fire prevention and fighting (PCCC) 'thẩm duyệt' approval from the provincial Fire Police under Decree No. 136/2020/ND-CP before use of premises for public office occupancy; install and maintain automatic fire alarm/suppression systems, and obtain a fire safety acceptance record (biên bản kiểm tra nghiệm thu) or rely on the building's valid fire certificate in a certified commercial building. Occupational safety: perform workplace environmental monitoring (noise, light, air quality) at least annually by a licensed measurement agency under Law on Occupational Safety and Hygiene; have the office manager complete a fire safety and workplace evacuation training; submit labor health records for employees; obtain a building structural inspection/occupancy certificate evidencing safe load-bearing and egress, and comply with QCVN 06:2021/BXD for office buildings and QCVN 22:2016/BXD for accessibility. Civil defense integration: ensure that the head office participates in the communal civil defense plan under Law on Civil Defense No. 2023/QH15, with annual drill records and emergency communication protocols.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: General Department of Taxation (Tong cuc Thue) of the Ministry of Finance of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam; national e-tax portal: https://etaxvn.gdt.gov.vn; e-invoice portal: https://hoadondientu.gdt.gov.vn
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-invested LLC incorporates through the provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI), which issues the Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC); the tax identification number (Ma so thue, MST) is automatically created with the ERC. The enterprise then (1) activates its tax dossier at the local Tax Department; (2) registers for electronic tax filing on the national eTax portal; (3) obtains a digital signature certificate for invoice signing; and (4) registers the electronic invoice template with the General Department of Taxation. A private charitable foundation must also secure its statutory operating license and apply for tax-exemption/charitable status decrees, while grant inflows require only treasury/bank account registration, not a separate VAT registration. Non-resident foreign entities with grant-making operations or contractors deriving Vietnam-source income register for a foreign contractor tax identification number through a Vietnamese paying agent or the local Tax Directorate.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation; resident LLC is a standalone taxpayer subject to 20% standard CIT on worldwide income; no pass-through classification; no default tax-exempt zone status.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election exists under Vietnamese law. A foreign-invested LLC may elect preferential CIT rates for incentivized sectors (e.g., 10% for high-technology, scientific research and technological development enterprises), reduced small-and-medium-enterprise rates (15% where revenue does not exceed VND 3 billion; 17% where revenue does not exceed VND 5 billion), and the unilateral foreign tax credit election in the annual CIT finalization return. Hybrid mismatch elections are not available; anti-hybrid and substance outcomes are imposed through the general anti-avoidance and transfer-pricing rules of Decree 132/2020/ND-CP.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT; thue gia tri gia tang - GTGT)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No statutory revenue threshold for VAT registration: any entity undertaking Vietnam taxable supplies must register. Only households and individual businesses with annual revenue not exceeding VND 100 million are outside the VAT system. A foreign-invested LLC is therefore always a compulsory VAT registrant irrespective of turnover. Foreign digital and cross-border suppliers without a local establishment must register on the Foreign Supplier E-Portal from the first Vietnam-source supply without a turnover threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory e-invoicing under Decree 123/2020/ND-CP and Circular 78/2021/TT-BTC. Businesses must issue XML e-invoices with a digital signature for each supply. E-invoices bearing a tax authority code must be cleared in real time through the General Department of Taxation's secure REST API (digital certificate plus XML/JSON envelope) before transmission to the buyer; e-invoices without a tax authority code, the standard for stable taxpayers, must be transmitted to the GDT data warehouse within one working day (T+1) after issuance and reported monthly. No physical fiscal stamping applies; tax clearance operates through the GDT's eTax and e-Invoice digital platform.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: The 0% VAT rate applies to goods exported from Vietnam, goods/services supplied to export-processing enterprises or non-tariff zones, and services rendered by Vietnamese enterprises to foreign enterprises/organizations for consumption outside Vietnam. Eligibility requires: (i) an international sale or offshore service contract; (ii) the goods having actually left Vietnam evidenced by a customs export declaration; (iii) the service being performed and consumed offshore; (iv) payment received from a foreign non-resident party; and (v) the receipt being shown as a foreign-currency inward remittance into the enterprise's Vietnam bank account. Domestic consumption services and catch-all excluded services (brokerage, tourism, advertising, reinsurance, credit) are not zero-rated. Grant distributions of a charitable endowment are treated as non-taxable fund transfers rather than zero-rated VAT supplies.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading / Air Waybill / consignment evidence for cross-border movement
Packing List and Certificate of Origin (if preference claimed)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export VAT refunds receive pre-refund risk-based audit scrutiny by the General Department of Taxation. Failure of the refund documentation test or non-repatriation of export proceeds within 180 days triggers reassessment of the 0% rate to 10% VAT, recovery of the refunded amount plus late-payment interest at 0.03% per day, and an administrative fine of up to 20% of the understated tax under Decree 125/2020/ND-CP. Intentional false-invoice or refund fraud attracts penalties of up to three times the evaded tax and criminal tax-evasion liability under the Vietnamese Penal Code.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Bank of Vietnam (SBV; Ngân hàng Nhà nước Việt Nam), exercising exclusive authority over foreign exchange administration, cross-border payment approval, capital account surveillance, and the licensing and supervision of credit institutions, foreign bank branches, and licensed payment intermediaries. The Foreign Exchange Control Division of SBV and its provincial branches operate the registration, reporting, and approval windows that apply to continuing foreign-invested treasury operations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vietnamese dong (VND) is a managed currency and is not freely convertible. Viet Nam accepted IMF Article VIII obligations in 2011, so current-account payments and transfers are nominally free from exchange controls, but licensed banks still require underlying documentary proof and statutory declarations at each conversion. Capital-account transactions, including FDI capital contributions, intercompany loans, foreign grants treated as retained endowment capital, and any outbound investment or offshore treasury placements, remain tightly controlled and require either mandatory designation of a specific bank account (the Direct Investment Capital Account or an SBV-approved foreign-currency account), prior SBV registration, or express SBV approval in the individual case. For a non-distributing private charitable foundation, the classical dividend-repatriation hurdle is largely moot because the charter is structured to prohibit profit distributions; nevertheless, any conversion or remittance of endowment funds, whether in or out, must be routed through the licensed bank of record, documented with the correct purpose code, and reported to SBV via the bank's mandatory transaction-reporting platform.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory foreign-currency surrender obligation exists in Viet Nam since Decree 70/2014/ND-CP abolished the former statutory conversion quotas. Export proceeds must still be repatriated and effectively credited to a foreign-currency account maintained at a licensed credit institution within 180 days of the export date, extendable to 365 days for projects expressly approved by SBV. For the subject charitable foundation, export activity would fall outside its constitutional objects; all foreign grant receipts, donations, and endowment contributions must be credited directly to the foundation's designated foreign-currency account at a licensed bank in Viet Nam and may not be netted, pre-credited, or settled through offshore collection accounts, which would constitute a violation of the foreign-currency circulation restrictions.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Joint Stock Commercial Bank for Foreign Trade of Vietnam (Vietcombank)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Foreign-currency demand account (VND, USD, EUR) + designated endowment sub-ledger

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank for Investment and Development of Vietnam (BIDV)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational account and foreign-currency account for statutory charitable fund balances

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Vietnam Joint Stock Commercial Bank for Industry and Trade (VietinBank)

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Multi-currency corporate account with sweep capabilities for grant receipts and cross-border disbursements

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Vietnam Technological and Commercial Joint Stock Bank (Techcombank)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational account and electronic banking platform for grant disbursements

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Military Commercial Joint Stock Bank (MB Bank)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low, with significant legal constraints. Viet Nam does not license offshore non-bank e-money institutions (EMIs) and does not recognize foreign EMI account numbers as permissible settlement accounts under Decree 52/2024/ND-CP on non-cash payments. A foreign digital EMI such as Wise, Airwallex, or Currencycloud may only enter the market through a licensed Vietnamese payment intermediary arrangement, and settlement must ultimately occur on the books of a licensed credit institution. Vietnamese banks will treat routing of charitable grant funds through offshore EMI omnibus accounts as a high-risk arrangement and may reject or suspend the instruction. The compliant architecture therefore mandates that all grant receipts and endowment movements clear directly over SWIFT to and from the foundation's licensed bank accounts in Viet Nam.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is mandatory for corporate onboarding. At least one lawful representative of the foundation, usually a member of the board of managers or a delegated authorized signatory holding a duly notarized power of attorney, must appear in person at the chosen bank branch or head office to execute the account agreement and complete the KYC interview. Fully remote or video-only opening of a corporate account is not permitted under the Law on Anti-Money Laundering (No. 12/2022/QH15) and the implementing Circular 09/2023/TT-NHNN; eKYC procedures are recognized only for natural persons. Designated signatories should also appear for signature-card completion, and each signatory's identification documents must be sighted by bank staff.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Statutory authorization gap: the applicant presents as a limited liability company but conducts philanthropic endowment business without a valid social or charitable fund establishment license issued by the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) under Decree 93/2019/ND-CP.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: The MHA establishment license for the social/charitable fund; the Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC) and Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) reflecting scope ISIC 6430; the notarized charter explicitly prohibiting profit distribution; a board resolution appointing account signatories and designating the authorized bank; and the SBV-approved fund charter provisions where required by local banking practice.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque foreign donor chain: inward grant flows from donors domiciled in high-risk or tax-haven jurisdictions, or transfers arriving from intermediaries rather than the named donor, creating FATF Recommendation 8 typology concerns regarding non-profit organization financing.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A bank-grade donor due-diligence pack containing the donor's certificate of incorporation and current constitutional documents, a full ownership and beneficial-ownership chain to natural persons, the donor bank's confirmation letter showing account relationship, the executed grand donation agreement describing the endowment program and purpose, signed sanctions and PEP screening results for all donor principals, and third-party corroboration of the donor's charitable or scientific purpose.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO and controller ambiguity: foreign founders holding the LLC through nominee or multi-layered equity structures, or unresolved identification of individuals holding 25% or more of the entity's ownership, rights, or control.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A completed beneficial-ownership declaration on the template required by Circular 09/2023/TT-NHNN; the shareholding ledger and capital contribution schedule of the LLC; notarized passports or long-stay residence cards of each individual beneficial owner; proof of residential address; the founding agreement and any shareholders' agreement establishing ultimate control over the endowment; and a written explanation of the ownership architecture acceptable to the bank's compliance committee.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Programmatic risk in grant outflows: disbursements to beneficiary individuals, research institutions, or non-profit organizations that are insufficiently identified or whose intended use of funds is expressed only in generic terms such as 'charitable support'.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A signed grant agreement for each disbursement identifying the beneficiary, the project, the amount, and the milestones; beneficiary KYC/KYB cards containing name, national ID or business registration number, and designated receiving bank details; an internal programmatic vetting report evidencing conflict-of-interest screening; a board-approved grant-disbursement policy; and a post-disbursement impact or utilization report retained in the treasury archive for at least five years and presented to the bank upon periodic review.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Treasury-flow mixing: commingling of donor-designated endowment assets, operational expenses, investment custody transactions, and grant distributions within a single ambiguous account profile, triggering suspicion of layering or unauthorized fund use.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A formal treasury manual approved by the board segregating account classes (endowment custody account, operational expense account, expenditure grant distribution account); a board-approved endowment investment policy defining permissible instruments and counterparties; monthly bank reconciliations tied to management accounts; annual audited financial statements of the foundation; and a standing instruction that all transactions carry a purpose code consistent with the foundation's licensed scope.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: For any contribution structured as charter capital of the foreign-invested LLC, the remitter must wire funds exclusively to the Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) opened by the foundation at a licensed bank under Circular 05/2021/TT-NHNN. The capital contribution schedule must align with the IRC and the charter's payment deadline, ordinarily 90 days from the date of the IRC, and each inward SWIFT MT103/MT202 instruction must carry the correct beneficiary account, the foundation's legal name, and the investment purpose code recognized by SBV for FDI capital contributions. The receiving bank will notify SBV through the statutory reporting system and will refuse credit to any non-designated account. For grant-style donations not structured as equity, the foundation must use a separate foreign-currency account approved for charitable receipts under the MHA establishment license; all such receipts must be supported by the underlying donation agreement and reported by the bank to SBV with the appropriate current-transfer purpose code. Any intercompany or shareholder loan intended to be part of the endowment must be first registered with SBV if it exceeds short-term trade credit thresholds, and must flow through the DICA as an eligible borrowing.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound treasury rail selection depends on payment class. Programmatic grant disbursements to foreign beneficiaries are executed through ordinary wire transfers via the SWIFT system using MT103 messages, carrying the designated beneficiary bank and account details and a purpose code consistent with a current-account transfer; the foundation must present the executed grant agreement and beneficiary identification to the bank at the time of instruction. For procurement of goods, services, or scientific equipment financed from the endowment, the foundation may use documentary trade instruments, including commercial letters of credit (L/C at sight or usance) and standby L/Cs or bank guarantees where counterparties require on-demand security; the documentation trail for L/Cs must include the underlying purchase contract, invoice, transport documents, and insurance certificate as applicable. All outward FX transfers require the foundation to first convert VND for USD/EUR at its authorized bank or to utilize existing foreign-currency grant balances, and every instruction must be accompanied by a completed purpose-of-payment declaration, otherwise the bank will block the remittance pending supplementary review.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable onshore foreign-exchange forward contracts between the foundation and its licensed custodian bank, with tenors up to a maximum of 365 days, available only where a genuine underlying transaction exposure exists and documented per Circular 15/2015/TT-NHNN.

FX swaps (VND against USD, EUR, or another freely convertible currency) executed onshore between the foundation and a licensed credit institution for cash-flow management, subject to the maturity and underlying-exposure documentation requirements of Circular 15/2015/TT-NHNN.

Plain-vanilla foreign-exchange options purchased from a licensed bank by the foundation (beneficial to the foundation as option holder) to cap conversion costs on committed foreign grant disbursements or scheduled endowment conversions.

Offshore VND non-deliverable forwards (NDFs), limited to non-resident counterparties transacting with the foundation; onshore entities in Viet Nam are not licensed to access an onshore NDF market, and the foundation may only use this instrument indirectly via a compliant foreign parent or donor if deemed contractually necessary and cleared by its legal counsel.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Enterprise Report (Báo cáo tình hình hoạt động)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Department of Planning and Investment / National Enterprise Registration Information Portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days from fiscal year-end; calendar-year entity by 31 March of the following year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine of VND 5,000,000–10,000,000 under Decree 122/2021/ND-CP; repeated non-filing may lead to deletion of the enterprise code from the national register.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Finalization Return and residual CIT payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Department of Taxation through the local Tax Department
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No later than the 90th day after the fiscal year-end; calendar-year taxpayers must file by 31 March.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing fines from VND 2,000,000–50,000,000 depending on delay; late-payment interest at 0.03% per day; non-declared income may be assessed by the tax authority.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local Tax Department, provincial Statistics Office, and provincial Department of Planning and Investment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after fiscal year-end; audited financial statements must be finalized and available with the annual report by the statutory deadline.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines under the Law on Accounting and Decree 41/2018/ND-CP for late submission or failure to obtain the statutory audit, up to VND 20,000,000 per violation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual business license fee declaration and payment (Lệ phí môn bài)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By 30 January each year; newly established businesses file within 30 days from business registration issuance.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative penalty plus late-payment interest at 0.03% per day; persistent non-payment may result in enforcement measures and registration suspension.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Charitable foundation annual activity and grant utilization report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Competent licensing body (provincial Department of Home Affairs or Ministry of Home Affairs, depending on scope)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after fiscal year-end or as specified in the foundation charter.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Warning or fine and possible suspension or revocation of the foundation license for failure to submit or misreporting grant utilization.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit applies to all foreign-invested LLCs under Decree 17/2012/ND-CP and the Law on Independent Audit; licensed charitable/endowment foundations are also within compulsory audit or financial verification scope regardless of revenue threshold.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: VAS (Vietnamese Accounting Standards) as statutory local GAAP; IFRS may be applied only in supplementary consolidated financial statements approved by the Ministry of Finance.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Viet Nam has no public UBO register. The LLC must maintain an internal beneficial-owner file under AML Law 2019 and update it promptly upon any member/shareholding transfer; the annual enterprise report discloses member percentages but is not a separate UBO confirmation filing.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Private charitable foundations operating as foreign-invested LLCs may qualify for a 10% preferential CIT rate for 15 years if the foundation is recognized as a social enterprise or engages in eligible areas (education, vocational training, healthcare, scientific research) under the Law on Corporate Income Tax and Decree 218/2013/ND-CP. Income from non-business public-benefit activities may be exempt if the foundation is recognized by the Ministry of Home Affairs and does not distribute profits. Capital gains and passive investment income (interest, dividends) remain subject to the standard 20% rate unless specifically covered by an investment incentive certificate.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form No. 02/TNDN (Corporate Income Tax Finalization Return) filed through the eTax electronic portal (https://etax.gdt.gov.vn). Quarterly provisional returns (Form 01/TNDN) must also be filed via the same portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Quarterly provisional CIT returns must be filed by the 30th day after the end of each quarter. Annual CIT finalization return must be filed within 90 days from the end of the fiscal year, together with full payment of the remaining tax liability.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box A – Identification section (Mã số thuế, tên người nộp thuế)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax identification number, full legal name of the LLC, registered head office address, and contact details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident foreign shareholders must ensure the Vietnamese entity uses the correct enterprise tax code and updates any changes in legal representatives.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box B – Section I: Revenue (Doanh thu)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total gross revenue from endowment management activities, including interest income, dividends, capital gains, and grant management fees. Charitable contributions received as donations are recorded separately as non-taxable revenue if conditions are met.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: All revenue generated by the Vietnamese LLC is subject to Vietnamese CIT, regardless of the residency of the ultimate shareholder. Foreign-sourced income of the Vietnamese entity is also taxable without a remittance requirement.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box C – Section II: Deductible expenses (Chi phí được trừ)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Allowable deductions directly incurred in generating revenue, including operational expenses, staff salaries, depreciation, and charitable program expenditures that meet the conditions under Circular 96/2015/TT-BTC.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Expenses paid to non-resident related parties must comply with transfer pricing rules and arm's-length requirements. Deductions are disallowed if documentation is incomplete.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box D – Section III: Taxable income (Thu nhập chịu thuế)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computed as revenue minus deductible expenses plus other taxable income, including income from raffles, sponsorships, or unrelated commercial activities.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders must not offset foreign losses against Vietnamese taxable income of the LLC.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Offset of prior-year losses within the 5-year limitation period, allocated between preferential-income and standard-income categories.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Losses of foreign shareholders cannot be transferred to the Vietnamese entity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Apply 20% standard rate, or 10% preferential rate if a valid incentive certificate is held and the activity qualifies.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign-invested LLCs must attach the Investment Registration Certificate and any CIT incentive approval to the finalization file.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line V – CIT payable (Thuế TNDN phải nộp)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after loss offset multiplied by the applicable CIT rate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Quarterly provisional payments must equal at least 75% of the final liability to avoid underpayment penalties.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Annex: Related-party transaction disclosure (Phụ lục giao dịch liên kết – Form 01/QL-KTT)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Disclosure of all related-party transactions, including management fees, loans, and service arrangements with foreign affiliates, with transfer pricing methodology documentation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident parents must provide transfer pricing documentation (Master File/Local File) if the entity meets thresholds under Decree 132/2020/ND-CP.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalties: administrative fines from VND 2,000,000 to VND 25,000,000 depending on delay, plus late payment interest at 0.03% per day. Underpayment penalties: 20% of the underpaid amount, plus interest. Criminal tax evasion can result in fines up to VND 4.5 billion and imprisonment up to 7 years.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% for foreign corporate shareholders receiving dividends from a Vietnamese LLC (Vietnam does not impose dividend WHT); however, profit repatriation requires annual audit, audited financial statements, and approval of the general meeting of members. Non-corporate or individual shareholders may be subject to personal income tax rules.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Because dividend WHT is 0%, DTA relief is generally not required for dividends. For other payments (royalties, interest, service fees), to invoke a DTA, the non-resident recipient must provide a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) issued by its home tax authority, a completed Form 01/HTBT-NNT, and a written declaration of beneficial ownership to the Vietnamese payer before the payment date. The payer submits these to the tax authority for approval to apply the reduced treaty rate. Retroactive treaty relief may be claimed within 5 years under the tax administration law.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rates under Foreign Contractor Tax: royalties: 10% CIT on gross royalty (plus 5% VAT); interest: 5% CIT (VAT-exempt). Under typical Vietnam DTAs, royalty WHT is reduced to 10% and interest WHT to 10% (many treaties) or as low as 5% for financial institutions. Royalty treaty rates may be reduced to 5%–15% depending on the treaty and IP type.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File and Master File preparation is mandatory if: (i) total revenue exceeds VND 50 billion, or (ii) total related-party transaction value exceeds VND 30 billion, or (iii) the entity has related-party transactions and is not a small or micro enterprise under Vietnamese law. De minimis exemption for SMEs: total revenue < VND 50 billion and total assets < VND 25 billion, with no related-party transactions exceeding the arm's-length threshold. Country-by-Country Report threshold: VND 18,000 billion consolidated group revenue.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Under Decree 132/2020/ND-CP, related-party transactions must reflect actual business substance. For a charitable foundation, economic substance requires: local decision-making, local employees, real office premises, and active grant management. Thin capitalization rule: net interest expenses exceeding 30% of EBITDA are non-deductible. Charitable status is contingent on ongoing operational substance; shell-like foundations risk profit re-characterization, retroactive taxation, and license revocation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Intentionally underreporting endowment investment income, inflating charitable grant deductions without verifiable beneficiaries, or using false invoices to reduce taxable profit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal penalties under the Penal Code 2015 (as amended): fine from VND 100 million to VND 4.5 billion and/or imprisonment from 6 months to 7 years. Administrative: penalty up to 3 times the evaded tax, late payment interest, and revocation of tax-free status.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and legal representatives can be held personally criminally liable, subject to travel bans, asset seizure, and extradition risk; civil restitution ordered by court.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating without real charitable activities, accumulating profits, or distributing income to founders while retaining charitable recognition; using the foundation as a conduit for related-party capital flows.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Revocation of the charitable foundation registration; retrospective CIT at 20% plus penalties; administrative fines under Decree 128/2020/ND-CP up to VND 100 million; forced dissolution.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Board members face personal liability for unauthorized distributions and fraudulent grant reporting; travel bans and prohibition from management roles in Vietnam.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to identify donors or beneficiaries, structuring grants to circumvent reporting thresholds, or accepting funds from unknown/high-risk sources without customer due diligence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines under the AML Law 2022 up to VND 1 billion; criminal sanctions under Penal Code Art. 324 (money laundering) with imprisonment up to 15 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers may face criminal prosecution if they knowingly facilitated money laundering; personal fines and seizure of assets; travel bans pending investigation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Paying excessive management fees to an offshore affiliate, using non-arm's-length interest rates on shareholder loans, or allocating endowment gains to a low-tax jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: TP adjustment by tax authorities; additional CIT at 20%; penalty 20-30% of additional tax; interest at 0.03%/day; administrative fines up to VND 25,000,000 for non-compliance with documentation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors can be jointly liable if they signed false TP documentation; criminal liability for fraudulent records; travel restrictions during TP audits.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Distributing profits before full CIT finalization, remitting funds without audited financial statements, or disguising dividends as management fees to avoid tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fine up to 100% of the illegally remitted amount; back taxes plus interest; suspension of foreign investment privileges.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be held personally liable for unauthorized remittances; criminal liability for illegal capital flight (Penal Code Art. 189); travel bans and asset freezes.
